# Terrain fixture provenance

`n43.dt0` is 34,162 bytes; SHA-256 `6fb965d94585ecb391f4b4194edd7bd9aad58c725e2cdbb376fd6f7c69688338`. It exactly matches [OSGeo GDAL sample](https://download.osgeo.org/gdal/data/dted/n43.dt0) and [GDAL test path](https://github.com/OSGeo/gdal/blob/master/autotest/cpp/data/n43.dt0). The same bytes were formerly at `samples/public/n43.dt0`. GDAL test history reaches 2007.

The header says unclassified, not copyright permission. General NGA/DTED and other GDAL samples’ public-domain statements do not complete the original permission chain for this exact filename. Retained as a reproducibility fixture pending owner/rights review; do not claim unrestricted clearance or ship it as default terrain on this notice alone. The application imports users’ authorized DTED files independently. Older Mapzen DTED2/NASA imagery captures have distinct sources and must not all be attributed to this file.
